decisions.statement: A window is known by its pid together with the moment that process started.
A pid is used again by a new process once the process holding that pid ends.
The command name is skipped by seeking the last closing bracket in the status.
The start time is the twentieth field after the command name in the status.
A field that is no finite number leaves the start time unread.
A status that cannot be read leaves the start time at zero.
Nothing here knows which pid the editor window is.
Nothing here knows the fields a window record holds.

definition: the pid and the start time a process is said by, read as one name
